information_flow: The first call sees all six common inputs and emits one immutable, provenance-visible analysis state coupling contractual obligations with interacting behavioral objectives. The final call consumes that state first and retains common-source visibility, but the committed state cannot be reopened, ranked, rolled back, pruned, or replaced; it is materialized once into one policy.
name: Constructive Obligation Typestate Relay
organization: two-call sequential relay with upstream commitment authority and downstream materialization authority

calls.objective: Identify contractual evidence and cross-objective interactions before any policy artifact exists, then commit one positive, internally coherent obligation state with visible provenance. Exclude local anchor edits, reversible deltas, alternatives, rankings, and postconstruction pruning.

Consume the immediately preceding committed obligation state as the controlling evidence and perform its single permitted state transition into one complete contract-compliant policy. Do not reopen commitments, repair the anchor locally, create rollback states, select among alternatives, or apply terminal compression.
